verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a built-in AI Helpbot, opened with cmd/ctrl+K, but it is documented only as answering questions and clarifying workflows from support content. Separately, it offers task-specific AI features: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence and GenAI DDQ autofills questionnaires. These give narrow delegation of specific jobs rather than a general assistant you hand work to, and the MCP server is for external assistants, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that takes actions on workspace objects (e.g., updating evidence requests or action items), a general task-delegation interface, and hands-on corroboration.
